snippet.title: Shot One Fighters | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Shot One Fighters!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2945040/

Follow our upcoming Kickstarter! : https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/shotonefighters/shot-one-fighters

Gameplay Begins: 0:17

SHOT ONE FIGHTERS is a Roguelite 2.5D Fighting game. Pick your fighter. Build your moveset and grow more powerful. Every artifact warps the rules. No two runs play the same. Jump into our cinematic story mode and discover the secrets of the void!
